description: A conversation, post, discussion, video, photo, album, file, task, poll, Posts module post, profile, group, space or event in a window of its own (windows.rs, labels win-*). It reads and replies and nothing more: its requests to the site's API, which Rust sends with the token of the session the window names (api_request, api_abort: api.rs; the window holds no token and has no network of its own), the session to name, uploads of photos for a reply and of files (picked in the dialog Rust opens, dropped or pasted; never a path), downloads of a file it shows (save_download: Rust asks where in its save dialog and writes the file there; no file system permission), lasting drafts in the drafts.json Rust opened (no load; the store plugin's permissions reach only that store, since the settings are Rust's: settings.rs), the settings to read (get_settings, for the theme and the keys; no set_setting), the delete question (dialog message), its posts' More and context menus as native pop-up menus that Rust builds from the items the page sends and answers to this window by its label (popup_menu, popup.rs), Copy Link (the clipboard plugin's write-text only, never a read), links in the browser (http and https), the theme for its title bar, its own Back and Forward state for the menu bar while it has focus (set_nav_state, kept per window: menu.rs), the live events of the public channels it names (realtime_watch: an open post's comments; Rust holds the one WebSocket, realtime.rs), and closing itself. Of the core permissions only what it uses: listening to events (drag and drop, the menu bar's Back, Forward and Refresh that menu.rs sends it), reading its window and web view, closing resources, its theme and closing itself; not core:default, whose emit and emit-to would let it send the main window menu commands (sign-out among them) or sync events, and whose tray and menu sets would let it change the tray icon or the app menu. No sign-in or sign-out, no new windows, no show or focus (Rust shows it), no dragging (native title bar), no title (Rust copies document.title: windows.rs), no window-state, tray, menu, badge or notifications.
